title.narrative: Pakistan 2022 Floods Response Relief and Early Recovery

description.narrative: Project Humanitarian Response Pakistan - 2022 Floods will be implemented through our partners both INGOs and NGOs and the consortium will be led by WHH. The project aims to reduce adverse impact of floods and strengthen the rehabilitation capacities of affected communities in the intervention districts affected by the floods in Pakistan. Through the project assistance, most vulnerable flood affected households in selected villages will be enabled to withstand the immediate life-threatening impacts of the flooding, meet their basic humanitarian needs (physical and mental) and become aware of their entitlements and rights in this emergency situation. The project duration is 6 months from October 6, 2022, to March 31, 2023 and the total grant volume is 5,653,493 GBP.

sector.narrative: 1. Provide access to immediate life-saving WASH assistance (emergency response and early recovery) to flood-affected target communities in selected districts.2. Provide access to comprehensive Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Services (MHPSS) and quality GBV care (in line with global IASC guidelines on MHPSS in humanitarian emergency settings) to flood affected population in targeted districts.
Multi-purpose cash grants, cash for work/trainings and transport vouchers to access health services and shelter) is provided to the most vulnerable HHs affected by the floods (emergency response)
